description: This PHP class defines the BuzzCommentAPI endpoint for a Human Resource Management system. It implements CRUD operations for managing comments on buzz/shares, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting comments. The class also handles validation rules, transaction management, and incorporates traits for authentication and database interaction.

classes.name: BuzzCommentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling CRUD operations related to buzz comments in the OrangeHRM HRM system. Implements methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting comments, with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment on a post based on shareId and commentId, returning it in a specified model format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all comments on a specific share, with sorting and pagination support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a specified share, managing database transactions and updating share comment count.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a specific comment after authorization, changing its text and updating modification timestamp.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment after authorization, managing share comment count updates and transactions.
